limitations: Speech/text service HTTP fixtures are deterministic loopback responses, proving workflow behavior rather than linguistic accuracy or live paid-provider compatibility.

The existing CPU installation regression runs actual native Whisper inference; original-only scoped workflow ASR remains mocked while real FFmpeg cropping/encoding and SQLite/preload/IPC are exercised.
GPU hardware, external live provider and packaged installer/icon checks are separate coordinator/backend-owned evidence; they are not claimed by these 19 desktop tests.
